adminManage.backup.title: Backup & Restore
adminManage.backup.subtitle: Export · Import · Encrypted at rest
adminManage.backup.notice.before: Full-DB backups are always encrypted with the server's
adminManage.backup.notice.after: environment variable (AES-256). Only someone with shell access to the server can decrypt the resulting file. Plain SQL dumps are rejected on import.
adminManage.backup.export.title: Database Export
adminManage.backup.export.description: Download a complete encrypted SQL dump of every table — settings, accounts, library caches, audit logs, password hashes. Use this for full server migration or disaster recovery.
adminManage.backup.restore.title: Database Restore
adminManage.backup.restore.description: Restore from a previously exported encrypted backup. Every table in the dump is truncated and re-inserted atomically — the database returns to the exact state at backup time. Failure rolls back.
adminManage.backup.notes.title: Operational notes
adminManage.backup.notes.sync: Exports are synchronous; large DBs may take up to 30s to generate.
adminManage.backup.notes.destructive: Restore is destructive: every listed table is truncated before re-insert, all in a single transaction. Any failure rolls back the entire restore — no half-restored state.
adminManage.backup.notes.migrations: Schema migrations are not run on import. Restore only into a server running the same version.
adminManage.backup.error.notEncrypted: Backup file is not an encrypted Summonarr dump.
adminManage.backup.confirm: This replaces the current database with the contents of this backup. Existing data will be overwritten and cannot be recovered. Continue?
